ResearchProjectDef.label: settled life
ResearchProjectDef.description: Bring together everything your people have learned to live off the land, and take the first step towards settled life. Completing this advances your colony to the neolithic era.

ResearchProjectDef.label: civilization
ResearchProjectDef.description: Farming, herding and craft have made your people a settled society. Completing this advances your colony to the medieval era.

ResearchProjectDef.label: industrialization
ResearchProjectDef.description: The crafts of the medieval world give way to machines and the power to drive them. Completing this advances your colony to the industrial era.

ResearchProjectDef.label: spacer technology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Master the technology of the stars that built the worlds around you. Completing this advances your colony to the spacer era.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ultratech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Push past spacer technology to the edge of what is understood. Completing this advances your colony to the ultra era.
